properties.name: Yaman Park
properties.description: Quiet carry-in launch on the Cayuga Inlet. Gentle current and easy parking make it a good spot for beginners; paddle out to the lake mouth or upstream toward the flood control channel.
properties.parking_notes: Free lot, about 10 spaces. Best water level is between 3.5 ft and 5 ft.

tracks.name: Inlet loop
tracks.description: Out-and-back from the launch to the lake mouth and back.

properties.name: Stewart Park
properties.description: Public boat launch at the south end of Cayuga Lake, right next to the fairgrounds. Wide-open water with room to spread out, but can get choppy when it's windy.

properties.name: Myers Point Park
properties.description: Sandy beach launch on the east side of Cayuga Lake. Good sunset paddling, and a short hop across to the Lansing shoreline.
properties.parking_notes: Small lot, fills up on summer weekends.
